description: A utility class 'SimpleTextWatcher' that simplifies implementing the TextWatcher interface by accepting a lambda for handling text change events, avoiding boilerplate code.

classes.name: SimpleTextWatcher
classes.description: A Kotlin class implementing TextWatcher to notify about text changes via a lambda function.

methods.name: beforeTextChanged
methods.description: No-op override of TextWatcher method, called before text is changed.

methods.name: afterTextChanged
methods.description: No-op override of TextWatcher method, called after text has changed.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Calls the provided lambda 'onChanged' with the new text as a string whenever text changes.
